## 6 Conclusion

Driven by applications in graphon games; we developed an estimator  for unknown graphon based on sampled network. Under standard regularity conditions for the graphon; our estimator possesses two features:   (i) it approximates the unknown in the operator norm; and (ii) it is of low rank. We established   upper   bounds for the convergence rate and rank of the estimator.
